GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 900m. Pushed to quicken @ 750m & chasing Four Wide @ 550m. Gave ground from home turn. # Always rearward.
Jumped Ok sat near last 6l off, took off midrace, faced breeze half off passing 800m, under whip turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on well but never threatening # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1200m, shifted out and was permitted to stride forward to settle outside the leader passing the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat back 6l off, held up turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, worked home well # margin unfair

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down last of four runners trailing 6 Lengths on fence, leader went mad in front leading 12 Lengths at 1200m coming back to lead 2 Lengths at 800m, railed to 4 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no threat 3rd place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out approaching the 1400m, then bumped and carried out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 4l off, worked home well with limited room # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Made the crossing near the 1600m very awkwardly and blundered.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide (slow pace), Drifted Back to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked widest (10-wide) Straightening Up and improved a couple of lengths in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # back/wide last 800m
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. under pressure turn. battled away # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn was steadied when awkwardly placed at the heels of a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace until improving on winner's back from 800m. Pushed to quicken @ 600m & pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & ground home OK in last 200m. # Wide/stuck on OK.

Jumped okay & Settled Down trailing just over 2 Lengths 3 Wide , (tearaway leader led 8 Lengths middle stages coming back from the 900m) moved up to 1.5 Lengths 3-4 Wide turning, Four Wide rounding turn, steered two lanes past centre of track Straightening Up , hit Lead 200m and kept going to post # wide/solid win
Jumped Ok drifted back to last 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
(ex danny o'brien) Jumped Well but soon Drifted Well Back Settled Down Two Wide next to last 12 Lengths @ 900m. back a long last into Straight . Dropped Out . Winner Led All The Way # always way back
Jumped Ok Restrained tail 16 Lengths Good Pace on Couldn'T Get Close synthetic hoof filler on # awful
